summary: VNET Group disclosed via Form 6-K a share purchase agreement under which PJ Millennium I and II (Buyers, affiliates of Contemporary Amperex Technology) will acquire up to 650,424,192 Class A ordinary shares from Success Flow and Choice Faith (Sellers, owned by Shandong Hi-Speed Holdings) at US$1.4486/ordinary share (US$8.6914/ADS) in cash, representing ~38.1% of VNET's outstanding shares. The board supports the deal; no advisors named. Closing is subject to approval by SDHG shareholders, expected Q4 2026. A voting and consortium agreement grants Founder Parties voting control over the Buyers' shares post-closing. Watch for regulatory/antitrust clearance and potential changes in shareholder structure.
